'''''Beetle''''' was a group of 6 [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] that were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The Alliance used the [[Obran Cluster/Legends|Obran Cluster]] to hide 6 [[Class-H cargo container|Class-H containers]] full of [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]]. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] soon learnt of the stash and placed a [[Mine Type A|minefield]] around the containers with [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] from [[Tau Squadron]] to [[Battle of the Obran Cluster|destroy]] any recovery effort from the Alliance. Although fully aware of the trap, [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] sent a squadron of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] with '''Beetle Group''' soon behind to pick up the containers. The Rebels needed to hold of Tau Squadron and other Imperial reinforcements long enough for '''Beetle''' to pick and leave with just one of the containers.

==Behind the scenes==
The outcome depends on what side the Player has chosen.
